# RingSlot - Professional Virtual Phone Numbers

RingSlot provides high-intent virtual phone numbers for instant SMS verification in over 170 countries. 
Optimized for developers and privacy-conscious users.

## Key Services
- Telegram Verification
- WhatsApp Verification
- Google Account Creation
- Crypto Payments (BTC, ETH, SOL, USDT)

## API Access
Full REST API available at /api. Documentation at /api-docs.
